name: The Leaning Tower of Panels
description: Restore a partially observed cylindrical sliding tower. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage; do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.
natural_language: Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Survey the four-floor tower through its front-third viewport, restore the numbered mural rings across every hidden seam, and leave the opening in the brass foundation bay within the visible move limit. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM, or page-state inspection; terminal, shell, or Python; address-bar or URL/query edits; reload or navigation; extensions; external applications; or any pre-existing, unrelated, blank, settings, or non-task tab.

metadata.source_notes: TRW-055 supplies the rotating cylindrical slide-puzzle and floor-restoration premise. TRW-030 supplies exact wraparound state transitions and recoverable puzzle controls. The generated mural, shortest-path construction, visuals, input modes, and replay grader are original.
metadata.notes: The original four-floor, six-sector construction is provisionally L4. The task has no autonomous evolution: memory is required because tower rotation hides earlier panel state, while every slide and rotation completes synchronously.
